title: Method to identify efficiently cleaved, membrane-bound, functional HIV-1 (Human Immunodeficiency Virus-1) envelopes
author: Samal, Bansal, et al.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid DNA by CsCl gradient
steps.instruction: Isolate high‑quality plasmid DNA using a cesium chloride density gradient and subsequent precipitation steps.

substeps.instruction: Perform alkaline lysis of bacterial cells and obtain 3 ml of crude plasmid DNA in TE (pH 8.0) buffer.
Add 4.5 g cesium chloride and 100 µl ethidium bromide (10 mg/ml) to a 15 ml Falcon tube, then add the TE‑DNA solution and mix thoroughly.
Transfer the mixture to a Beckman Polyallomer ultracentrifuge tube using a syringe, seal, and weigh (target weight 9.9–10 g).
Centrifuge in an Optima XE‑100 Beckman Coulter ultracentrifuge (NVT 100 rotor) at 227 000 × g, 22 °C for 18–22 h.

After centrifugation, unseal the tube and collect the closed‑circular DNA band by puncturing just below the band with a 10 cc syringe fitted with an 18‑gauge needle; use long‑wave UV light if needed for visualization.
Remove ethidium bromide by extracting the collected DNA six times with an equal volume of water‑saturated n‑butyl alcohol (or until the pink color disappears).
Add 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.0) to reach a final concentration of 0.3 M, then invert the tube 4–5 times.
Add isopropanol equal to 0.7 × the total volume to precipitate the DNA.
Centrifuge at 3 214 × g, 4 °C for 30 min in a tabletop centrifuge; discard supernatant.
Wash the DNA pellet with 70 % ethanol, air‑dry, and finally dissolve in nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Seed 293F cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Prepare a suspension culture of 293 F cells at the appropriate density for transfection.

substeps.instruction: One day before transfection, split 293 F cells and seed at 1.2 × 10⁶ cells /ml in 500 ml FreeStyle 293 Expression medium.
Maintain the suspension culture in a CO₂ shaker‑incubator under standard conditions.

steps.title: Prepare transfection reagents
steps.instruction: Make the DNA‑PEI transfection mixture using OptiMEM and PEI MAX.

substeps.instruction: Pre‑warm 20 ml OptiMEM (reduced‑serum medium) to 37 °C in each of two 50 ml Falcon tubes.
To tube A add 800 µg plasmid DNA encoding the antibody heavy chain and 400 µg plasmid DNA encoding the light chain.
To tube B add 4 ml PEI MAX (Linear Polyethylenimine Hydrochloride, 1 mg/ml stock).
Incubate both tubes at room temperature for 5 min.
Combine tube A with tube B, mix slowly but thoroughly by inverting, and incubate the mixture at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Transfect cells and post‑transfection culture
steps.instruction: Introduce the DNA‑PEI complex to the 293 F cells and allow antibody expression.

substeps.instruction: Add the entire transfection mixture to the flask containing the 293 F cell suspension.
The following day, add an additional 500 ml FreeStyle 293 Expression medium to the flask.
Continue incubation for 5 days to allow antibody secretion.

steps.title: Harvest antibody‑containing supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the culture supernatant that contains secreted antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 13 750 × g, 4 °C for 30 min using a Sorvall RC6+ centrifuge.
Transfer the clarified supernatant to a fresh tube and store at –80 °C until purification.

steps.title: Purify antibodies via Protein A chromatography
steps.instruction: Isolate IgG from the harvested supernatant using a Protein A agarose column and prepare the final antibody stock.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the frozen supernatant on ice and load it onto a Protein A agarose column (4 ml beads) that has been pre‑washed with ice‑cold PBS.
Wash the column with 40–80 ml ice‑cold PBS to remove unbound proteins.
Elute bound antibodies with 10–15 ml elution buffer (100 mM glycine‑HCl, pH 2.5).
Immediately neutralize the eluate by adding 1 M Tris‑HCl, pH 8.5.
Dialyze the neutralized antibody solution overnight at 4 °C against 1 L ice‑cold PBS.
Concentrate the dialyzed antibodies using Amicon Ultra centrifugal filters (30 kDa cutoff).
Determine the protein concentration (e.g., by absorbance at 280 nm).
Aliquot the concentrated antibody solution and store the aliquots at –80 °C.
